dossier.identity: restorative photon-spore operator who converts overhealing into hardlight shields and deploys nectar-drone gardens across the lane~ :3
dossier.selectionRationale: bloom-rifle sustain and multi-bolt spore chains reward proactive topping-off and shootable garden constructs, preserving a cozy preventative loop distinct from nyra's emergency trauma saves and vesper's life-siphon tethers.
dossier.weaponConcept: bloom rifle (restorative photon rifle with flower optic, spore-cell ampoule carousel, mint coolant channels, and autonomous nectar-spore pods)

lore.backstory: former botanical synth-biologist from the upper greenhouse domes who stole an experimental photon-spore rifle when the board decided clean air was a premium subscription tier~ uwu. now she wanders the ruined sectors turning toxic concrete into glowing mint-pink sanctuaries for anyone who asks nicely n__n.
lore.syndicateRecord: wanted for unauthorized bio-luminescent terraforming of three corporate toll plazas and refusing to charge civilians for cellular regeneration.
lore.psychProfile: effortlessly warm, curves and charisma for days, treats active warzones like a slightly unruly community garden that just needs a little extra fertilizer xo.
lore.combatQuote: “care spreads further than you think, bestie~ stand in the flowers before i have to compost your attacker myself :3”

iconFamily.subject: a bold flower with a single chunky photon spore above its centre
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Fable. Theme: spore bloom. Subject: a bold flower with a single chunky photon spore above its centre. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
